description: VIEW PHOTOS HERE Today, lifelong Alaskan Mary Peltola laid out her vision for Alaska’s nearly 120,000 seniors at the Bartlett Community Forum, vowing to strengthen and protect Social Security and Medicare, bring down costs, and restore Alaska’s fisheries. “It was great to speak face-to-face with Alaskans about the issues we’re facing,” said Mary Peltola. “I will always fight […]
